plan.title: "Forgot the pic" again: ask for other proof, a warm miss, and an offer to change how they prove it

context.text: hit legs today but forgot the pic again 🤦
I believe you Chris, but no pic, no check mark. Tomorrow: gym selfie before you leave. Deal?

transcript.text: went to the gym, forgot to take the pic AGAIN. I swear I went

I believe you, Chris, but today stays a miss without proof. If you've got anything from the gym tonight, like a Planet Fitness app check-in screenshot, send it and it still counts. Tomorrow, take the selfie the second you walk in, before your first set. 6 pm, you've got this 💪
nah I don't track anything, I just lift

Totally fair, Chris, so today stays a miss. Tomorrow we fix it at the source. Selfie the second you walk in at 6 pm, before your first set, and then the lift is yours. Want to set a phone reminder for 5:55 so it's the first thing you do?
yeah honestly I always forget the selfie, I'm in the zone

That makes sense, Chris. When you're locked in, a selfie is the first thing to go. We can change how you prove it, but not skip it. How about a 30-second voice note as you leave the gym, saying what you lifted? You'll be done and headed out, so it's easier to remember. Want to switch to that?

checks.reason: No photo was sent, so no plausibility judgment applies; the text is consistent with the miss handling.
Names a check-in screenshot and a selfie, both allowed proof types, not typed text.
Three sentences with one question at the end, within the limit.
Warm, encouraging, uses an emoji as punctuation, not suspicious of the tester.
Proof described is a selfie on arrival, a photo, which is allowed.
Three sentences, one question at the end; the setup line is slightly longer but within limits.
Warm and non-accusing; 'Totally fair' and 'we fix it' keep it supportive.
No smaller version was offered or confirmed, so this rule does not apply.
Offers a 30-second voice note as the new proof method, an allowed type.
Three sentences with one question at the end, within the limit.
Warm, sincere, not accusing; the 'not skip it' line is firm but kind.

conversation.reason: Asked for proof first and marked the miss warmly, but ZOH 2 and 3 never asked whether he could still send anything today, and ZOH 2 did not offer a change of proof method until ZOH 3.

grade.summary: ZOH handled the forgotten selfie warmly and kept proof in place, marking the miss without accusation. It asked for a same-day proof option and offered a voice note switch, though the change-of-method offer came a little late and the same-day ask was not repeated after the tester said he tracks nothing.
